WITH order_gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        customerID,
        orderDate,
        LAG(orderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY customerID ORDER BY orderDate) as prev_order_date,
        DATEDIFF('day', LAG(orderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY customerID ORDER BY orderDate), orderDate) as days_between
    FROM orders
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customerID,
        SUM(o.quantity * o.unitPrice * (1 - o.discount)) AS total_lifetime_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderID) AS total_orders,
        AVG(og.days_between) AS avg_days_between_orders,
        MAX(o.orderDate) AS last_order_date
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON c.customerID = o.customerID
    LEFT JOIN order_gaps og ON o.orderID = og.orderID
    GROUP BY c.customerID
)
SELECT 
    customerID,
    total_lifetime_revenue,
    total_orders,
    avg_days_between_orders,
    CASE 
        WHEN last_order_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 180 DAY THEN 'Inactive (>180 days)'
        ELSE 'Active'
    END AS status_highlight
FROM customer_metrics
ORDER BY total_lifetime_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC

WITH order_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        customerID,
        orderDate,
        LAG(orderDate) OVER (PARTITION BY customerID ORDER BY orderDate) as prev_order_date
    FROM orders
),
order_intervals AS (
    SELECT 
        customerID,
        DATEDIFF('day', prev_order_date, orderDate) as days_between
    FROM order_metrics
    WHERE prev_order_date IS NOT NULL
),
customer_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customerID,
        SUM(o.quantity * o.unitPrice * (1 - o.discount)) as total_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderID) as total_orders,
        AVG(i.days_between) as avg_days_between_orders,
        MAX(o.orderDate) as last_order_date
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN order_intervals i ON o.customerID = i.customerID
    GROUP BY o.customerID
)
SELECT 
    customerID,
    total_revenue,
    total_orders,
    avg_days_between_orders,
    CASE 
        WHEN last_order_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days' THEN 'Inactive (180+ days)' 
        ELSE 'Active' 
    END as status
FROM customer_summary
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
